en.dr-ali-peiravi: 24-2 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya al-Jaloodi quoted Abu Hamid al-Taleqani, on the authority of Abdul Aziz ibn al-Khat’tab, on the authority of Tolid ibn Suleiman, on the authority of Layth, that Mujahid said,

“Seventy verses (of the Holy Quran) have been revealed about Ali (MGB) in which none of the other noble ones have any part.”The Reward of One who Implores Forgiveness Seventy Times in the Qunut of Al-Witr Prayer
